assertions.title: Kanban board loads with 6 status columns when empty workspace
test_names: renders 6 columns in order: Backlog, Open, Blocked, In Progress, Review, Done
handles empty API response gracefully
empty columns show 0 issues badge
assertions.notes: kanban-column-redesign.spec.ts verifies all 6 data-status columns (backlog, ready, blocked, in_progress, review, done) render in correct order. kanban.spec.ts verifies the board loads with empty data (0 issues).

assertions.title: Empty column shows contextual message per status
test_names: empty columns show 0 issues badge
assertions.notes: Test verifies '0 issues' count badge on empty columns but does NOT verify the contextual placeholder message text that should vary per status (e.g., 'No tasks in backlog' vs 'Nothing in progress').

assertions.title: Single column with 1 card displays card title, ID, and priority indicator
test_names: issues load into correct Kanban columns
card title uses h3 element with normal weight
P0 badge renders with data-priority=0
assertions.notes: Title rendering (h3) and priority badge (data-priority) are verified. The issue ID badge on the card is NOT explicitly asserted in any test — only title and priority are covered.

assertions.title: All 5 columns visible and unobstructed in single screen when few issues
assertions.notes: No test verifies layout fit / obstruction behavior at a given viewport. (Note: board now has 6 columns, not 5 — the assertion is stale but still tests a distinct layout property.)

assertions.title: Board height fills available container; columns scrollable vertically when tall
assertions.notes: No test checks container-height filling or per-column vertical scroll behavior with long card lists.

assertions.title: None grouping (flat board) delegates to KanbanBoard component
test_names: groupBy="none" shows flat KanbanBoard without swim lanes
flat view renders KanbanBoard without any swim lane elements
KanbanBoard renders when groupBy is none
no grouping headers shown in flat view
assertions.notes: Flat view (groupBy=none) is explicitly verified to render KanbanBoard without swim lane elements across multiple specs.

assertions.title: Issue card displays title, ID, priority color, type icon, assignee avatar
test_names: issues load into correct Kanban columns
P0 badge has warm red background (#e24b3b)
in-progress card with matching agent shows AgentRow with status
assertions.notes: Title and priority-color badge are covered across redesign specs. AgentRow (assignee presence) is tested for in_progress cards. The ID badge and type icon are NOT explicitly asserted. Assignee avatar is only covered for in_progress state.

assertions.title: Long card title truncates with ellipsis when exceeds single line
assertions.notes: No test seeds a long title and asserts CSS ellipsis/truncation behavior.

assertions.title: Priority color-coding consistent across all cards (P0-P4, undefined default)
test_names: P0 badge has warm red background (#e24b3b)
P1 badge has orange background (#ef7f4a)
P2 badge has warm yellow background (#f0b24a)
P3 badge has soft blue background (#5b85f7)
P4 badge has gray background (#6b7280)
all priority badges render with correct text across columns
assertions.notes: Explicit P0-P4 background-color assertions plus cross-column rendering check. Undefined/default priority is not explicitly covered but P0-P4 consistency is proven.

assertions.title: Blocked badge shows N on card when issue blocked by dependencies
test_names: blocked cards display blocked badge with count
assertions.notes: Test seeds blocked_by_count=2 and asserts the article has data-blocked="true" and is visible — but does NOT assert the badge text displays the count number '2'.

assertions.title: Blocked badge tooltip shows blocker issue IDs and titles on hover
assertions.notes: No hover-tooltip test for the blocked badge listing blocker IDs/titles.

assertions.title: Review badge (Plan/Code/Help) appears on cards in review status with feedback
assertions.notes: No test for Plan/Code/Help review-feedback badge variants on review-status cards.

assertions.title: Open status badge shows two-state system: Needs Plan vs Ready
assertions.notes: No kanban card test distinguishes Needs Plan vs Ready sub-states for open issues. (Needs Planning appears in monitor/dashboard tests but not kanban cards.)

assertions.title: Card shows repo badge when in multi-repo workspace
assertions.notes: No test seeds a multi-repo workspace state and verifies a repo badge on the card.

assertions.title: Drag handle icon visible on all cards (6-dot grip icon)
assertions.notes: No test asserts the presence of a 6-dot grip-icon drag handle. Cards are draggable but the handle icon is not checked.

assertions.title: Card shows pending/optimistic update indicator (skeleton or muted opacity)
test_names: drag shows visual feedback during operation
assertions.notes: Opacity 0.5 during active drag is asserted, but this is drag-visual-feedback, not a pending/optimistic update skeleton state while awaiting server response. Non-drag optimistic indicators are untested.

assertions.title: Drag open issue to in_progress column triggers assignee prompt modal
assertions.notes: No test exercises the assignee-prompt modal that should appear when dragging into in_progress without an assignee.

assertions.title: Assignee modal Assign sends PATCH with both status and assignee
assertions.notes: No test verifies the modal Assign path sends PATCH with both status and assignee fields.

assertions.title: Assignee modal skip sends PATCH with status only (no assignee)
assertions.notes: No test verifies the modal Skip path sends PATCH with status only.

assertions.title: Drag in_progress to review column sends PATCH with status change
test_names: drag issue from Ready to In Progress updates status and persists
drag issue from Ready to Review updates status
drag issue from Review to Closed updates status
assertions.notes: Drag-and-PATCH is tested for Ready→In Progress, Ready→Review, and Review→Closed, but in_progress→review specifically is not tested.

assertions.title: Drag review to in_progress sends PATCH with status change
assertions.notes: Reverse direction (review→in_progress) is not exercised by any drag test.

assertions.title: Drag to same column (no status change) results in no-op (no API call)
assertions.notes: No test asserts that dragging a card back to its own column issues zero PATCH calls.

assertions.title: Blocked issue drag restricted to allowed targets only
assertions.notes: No test asserts drag-from-blocked is constrained to a specific whitelist of target columns.

assertions.title: Drag overlay (ghost card) follows cursor during drag
test_names: drag shows visual feedback during operation
assertions.notes: Explicitly asserts the DragOverlay element is visible during the drag (targets [class*="overlay"] with an article descendant) and has elevated box-shadow.

assertions.title: Drop zone highlight appears on column when hovering during drag
test_names: drag shows visual feedback during operation
assertions.notes: Asserts data-is-over="true" on the drop target and that the contentDropOver class is applied while hovering.

assertions.title: Drag blocked→closed succeeds (drag enabled out of blocked column)
assertions.notes: No test drags a blocked card into the closed/done column.

assertions.title: Drag restricted by allowedDropTargets (whitelist of column IDs)
assertions.notes: No test verifies the allowedDropTargets whitelist semantics.

assertions.title: Cross-lane drag moves card to target lane's column (when ungrouped)
test_names: drag issue within same lane changes status
assertions.notes: Only within-same-lane drag is tested. Cross-lane drag behavior (swim-lane→swim-lane) is not covered.

assertions.title: PATCH request body includes correct workspaceId and issueId in URL
test_names: drag issue from Ready to In Progress updates status and persists
assertions.notes: Test asserts the URL includes /api/issues/<issueId>, but the current URL shape does not carry a workspaceId segment — so workspaceId-in-URL is unverified (and may not match the contract).

assertions.title: Drag failure shows error toast with message; card snaps back to original column
test_names: shows error toast and rolls back card on drag failure
assertions.notes: 500 PATCH triggers the error-toast testid with role="alert" and the card is verified back in the original Ready column.

assertions.title: Drag during network failure shows Network error toast
test_names: shows error toast and rolls back card on drag failure
assertions.notes: Covers server 500 responses with an error toast, but does NOT exercise a network-failure path (e.g., aborted fetch / offline) nor assert a 'Network error' toast message specifically.

assertions.title: Simultaneous drag by two users results in last-write-wins (no conflict UI)
assertions.notes: No multi-user concurrency scenario is simulated.

assertions.title: PATCH includes only changed fields (status, assignee as applicable)
test_names: drag issue from Ready to In Progress updates status and persists
drag issue within same lane changes status
assertions.notes: Both tests assert patchCalls[0].body.toEqual({ status: ... }) — proving the PATCH body contains only the changed status field, no unrelated fields.

assertions.title: Optimistic update reflects card in new column before API responds
test_names: drag shows visual feedback during operation
assertions.notes: Drag moves the card and the new column shows the card, but the assertion is strictly that this happens BEFORE the API responds. Tests waitForResponse on PATCH before checking position — optimistic-before-response is not isolated.

assertions.title: Assignee modal remembers recent selections (localStorage)
assertions.notes: No localStorage-persisted assignee modal test.

assertions.title: New issue created by another user appears in board in real-time
test_names: create issue via API appears in UI
assertions.notes: Integration test creates an issue via API and waits for it to appear in the ready column via SSE connection. Requires RUN_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1.

assertions.title: Issue status change via SSE moves card to new column (remote update)
assertions.notes: Integration tests only cover create and close via SSE. No SSE-driven status-change-moves-card test.

assertions.title: Issue updated with assignee change reflects on card immediately
assertions.notes: No SSE assignee-change test.

assertions.title: Drag mid-flight + SSE arrival: card stays in drag target (optimistic wins)
assertions.notes: No test simulates an SSE arriving during an in-progress drag.

assertions.title: Issue deleted via SSE is removed from board (card disappears)
test_names: close issue via API removes from ready column
assertions.notes: Integration test closes an issue via API and verifies SSE propagation removes it from the ready column. Requires RUN_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1.

assertions.title: Column count updates live when issue added/removed via SSE
assertions.notes: No test asserts the count badge increments/decrements on SSE add/remove events.

assertions.title: Blocked status change via SSE updates blocked badge on affected cards
assertions.notes: No SSE-driven blocked-badge update test.

assertions.title: Filter-active board: SSE card moves but remains filtered (if filter matches)
assertions.notes: No test combining active filter and SSE-driven update.

assertions.title: Filter active: only matching cards displayed; other cards hidden
test_names: priority filter reduces visible issues in flat view
type filter works with flat view
groupBy works with type filter
groupBy works with priority filter
assertions.notes: groupby-none flat kanban tests verify priority-filter and type-filter reduce visible articles to only matching cards. swimlane-wiring also covers the filtered+grouped case.

assertions.title: Drag of filtered card within column has no effect (reorder not supported when filter active)
assertions.notes: No test combines active filter with drag-reorder and asserts no-op.

assertions.title: Column with 200+ cards uses virtual scrolling (not all DOM nodes rendered)
assertions.notes: No virtualization test in any kanban/swimlane/groupby spec (grep for 'virtual' returns zero hits).

assertions.title: Virtual scroll preserves card state when scrolling in/out
assertions.notes: No virtualization test.

assertions.title: Tab key navigates between cards in reading order
assertions.notes: No Tab-focus-between-cards test in kanban specs.

assertions.title: Enter key on focused card opens detail panel
assertions.notes: Click-opens-detail-panel is covered, but keyboard Enter is not tested for kanban cards.

assertions.title: Space key on focused card initiates drag
assertions.notes: Space-to-drag keyboard initiation is not tested on kanban cards (swimlane-collapse uses Space for collapse toggle, not drag).

assertions.title: Escape key cancels drag and returns card to original position
assertions.notes: No Escape-cancels-drag test.

assertions.title: Arrow keys navigate to adjacent columns during keyboard drag
assertions.notes: No arrow-key-keyboard-drag test.

assertions.title: Blocked badge has aria-label describing blocker count
assertions.notes: No aria-label assertion on the blocked badge.

assertions.title: At 768px width (tablet), board reflows to 2-3 columns per row
assertions.notes: No tablet-viewport test in kanban/swimlane/groupby specs (grep for '768' returns zero hits).

assertions.title: At 480px width (mobile), board shows single column or horizontal scroll
assertions.notes: No mobile-viewport test.

assertions.title: Column header shows count and auto-updates when cards added/removed
test_names: column count badges show correct counts
drag issue from Ready to In Progress updates status and persists
assertions.notes: Column counts are verified via getByLabel('N issue(s)'). The drag test implicitly confirms count updates (source column goes from 2→1, destination 1→2).

assertions.title: Closed column shows Completed status label and distinct styling
test_names: column headers display correct labels
renders 6 columns in order: Backlog, Open, Blocked, In Progress, Review, Done
assertions.notes: Done column header text is verified as 'Done' (not 'Completed' per the assertion). Distinct styling for the closed column is not asserted.

assertions.title: Column header has aria-label describing column
assertions.notes: No aria-label assertion on column section headers (only the 'N issue(s)' count badge uses aria-label).

assertions.title: Drag with invalid status target rejected silently
assertions.notes: No test drags to an invalid target and asserts silent rejection.

assertions.title: Drag with network timeout (>30s) shows error toast and rolls back
assertions.notes: Timeout-specific path is not simulated. (Note: standard Playwright makes 30s+ scenarios unsuitable; may need a specialized mock-delay test.)

assertions.title: Very long issue ID displays without truncation in card
assertions.notes: No long-ID rendering test.

assertions.title: Reassigning card to same assignee does not trigger change (PATCH still sent)
assertions.notes: No same-assignee-reselect test.

assertions.title: Clicking card opens issue detail panel on right side
test_names: clicking a card opens the IssueDetailPanel
assertions.notes: Explicit click-opens-panel test asserts the issue-detail-panel testid or equivalent locator becomes visible after clicking a card.

assertions.title: Closing detail panel does not navigate away from Kanban view
assertions.notes: No test closes the panel from kanban and verifies the URL/kanban view persists.

assertions.title: Kanban board updates when issue changed in detail panel
assertions.notes: No test edits an issue in the detail panel and verifies the board card reflects the change.

assertions.title: Kanban board respects workspace-level filter state (from FilterBar)
test_names: priority filter reduces visible issues in flat view
type filter works with flat view
groupBy persists after applying other filters
groupBy combines with priority filter in URL
groupBy combines with type filter in URL
assertions.notes: FilterBar controls (priority-filter, type-filter testids) are verified to filter visible kanban cards in flat view and swim-lane view.

assertions.title: Store optimistic update shows card in new column before API response
test_names: drag shows visual feedback during operation
assertions.notes: Cards do move to the target column after drag completes, but tests wait for PATCH response before asserting final position. Optimistic-before-response timing is not isolated.

assertions.title: Store rollback on PATCH failure restores card to original column + status
test_names: shows error toast and rolls back card on drag failure
assertions.notes: 500 PATCH triggers a verified rollback: card returns to Ready, In Progress column drops to 0 articles.

assertions.title: Refetch issues repopulates board from API (full sync)
test_names: drag issue from Ready to In Progress updates status and persists
assertions.notes: The drag test calls page.reload() and verifies cards repopulate via /api/ready, but this is a page-reload refetch, not an explicit store-level refetch call.

assertions.title: Drag animation is smooth (60 fps) without jank
assertions.notes: Performance (60fps/jank) is not measurable with standard Playwright assertions and has no test.

assertions.title: Board does not re-render all columns when single card changes
assertions.notes: No render-count test (React DevTools/profiler).

assertions.title: Keyboard drag-drop with Space/arrows/Esc
assertions.notes: No keyboard drag-and-drop test on kanban cards.

assertions.title: Keyboard drag announces state to screen readers
assertions.notes: No aria-live / screen-reader announcement test for drag state.

assertions.title: Virtualization or memoization prevents all-column re-render on drag
assertions.notes: No render-count-on-drag test.

assertions.title: SSE burst of 100 mutations in 1s coalesces to ≤10 re-renders
assertions.notes: No burst/throttle test; inherently hard to verify with standard Playwright.

assertions.title: Optimistic UI rollback on 409 conflict
test_names: shows error toast and rolls back card on drag failure
assertions.notes: Rollback is tested for HTTP 500 but NOT 409 specifically. The contract specifically calls out 409 conflict handling.

assertions.title: Optimistic rollback preserves other local edits
assertions.notes: No scenario where concurrent local edits exist during a failing drag to verify preservation.

assertions.title: URL deep link round-trips groupBy, filter, search
test_names: groupBy combines with priority filter in URL
groupBy combines with type filter in URL
groupBy combines with search filter in URL
changing groupBy preserves other filter params
loading page with groupBy param restores dropdown selection
assertions.notes: Explicit tests verify groupBy+filter+search URL params round-trip and mutually persist.

assertions.title: Deep link is shareable across sessions
test_names: shared/bookmarked URL loads correct groupBy state
groupBy state preserved through page refresh
assertions.notes: Simulates opening a bookmarked URL and verifies the state (dropdown + swim-lane-board testid) matches the URL params.

assertions.title: Invalid URL params fall back to defaults without crash
test_names: invalid groupBy value falls back to 'epic'
groupBy values are case-sensitive
invalid groupBy URL param defaults to epic swim lane view
invalid URL param defaults to 'Epic'
assertions.notes: Multiple specs verify invalid/unknown groupBy values fall back to the epic default without error.

assertions.title: Drag failure rolls back card and surfaces error toast without auto-retry
test_names: shows error toast and rolls back card on drag failure
assertions.notes: Rollback and error toast are verified on 500. But the 'without auto-retry' property (no duplicate PATCH calls after failure) is not explicitly asserted — patchCalls length after the failed drag is not checked.
